response.consequence: Users who follow the unsubscribe link more than once, or whose mail client prefetches links, end up with the topic muted instead of at regular. response.explanation: The unsubscribe action, served on GET, toggles the notification level. A level above regular is set to regular. Any level at or below regular, including regular itself, is set to muted. Loading the link once from a watching level lowers it to regular. A reload, an email-client link prefetch, or a second click then mutes the topic. TopicUser.find_by can also return nil for a user with no TopicUser row for the topic, such as a user who was emailed but never visited. In that case tu.notification_level raises NoMethodError and returns a 500.
response.title: GET unsubscribe action is non-idempotent and can crash on missing TopicUser
